programme.title: Dracin
programme.desc: Love Lurking tells the story of Gu Nian, a talented surgeon whose life changes drastically after she saves the life of a drug trafficking prisoner known as K. Unknowingly, she becomes entangled in the dangerous world of a criminal cartel. What begins as a partnership gradually turns into a complicated romance amid constant tension and danger. As the threat intensifies, K risks his life to protect Gu Nian from the cartel boss, Peng Li.

programme.title: Dracin
programme.desc: Drama Cinta yang Tersembunyi (Love Lurking) mengisahkan Gu Nian, seorang dokter bedah yang hidupnya berubah drastis setelah menyelamatkan seorang narapidana kasus narkoba bernama K. Tanpa disadari, ia terseret ke dalam dunia gelap kartel kriminal. Awalnya bekerja sama sebagai rekan, hubungan Gu Nian dan K perlahan berkembang menjadi cinta yang rumit di tengah situasi berbahaya. Saat ancaman semakin nyata, K rela mempertaruhkan nyawanya untuk melindungi Gu Nian dari bos kartel, Peng Li.

programme.title: 64' ACTU

programme.title: 64' DÉBAT

programme.title: 64' DÉBAT
programme.desc: 64' Débat mempertemukan jurnalis dan pakar untuk membahas isu politik, sosial, dan ekonomi yang sedang berkembang.

programme.title: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026
programme.desc: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026 features Patrick Simonin in conversations with artists, writers, actors, and other notable personalities. Through engaging interviews, guests discuss their careers, projects, experiences, and the topics shaping current cultural and public life.

programme.title: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026
programme.desc: INVITE TV5MONDE (L') 2026 menghadirkan Patrick Simonin dalam wawancara bersama artis, penulis, aktor, dan berbagai tokoh terkenal. Para tamu berbagi cerita tentang karier, karya, pengalaman, serta berbagai topik yang menjadi perhatian dalam kehidupan budaya dan masyarakat saat ini.

programme.title: C DANS L'AIR
programme.desc: All the latest major events, presented, explained and analysed! Special guests and journalists in the studio analyse both the latest news but also other controversial issues to give us a better understanding of the social, political and cultural events occurring around us.

programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE
programme.desc: Les Belges du Bout du Monde is a long-running Belgian travel and cultural magazine hosted by Adrien Joveneau. The program takes viewers on journeys across the globe to discover the lives of Belgian citizens who have chosen to settle abroad. Through personal interviews, local discoveries, and encounters with different communities, the show explores themes of migration, cultural exchange, adventure, and human connection. Each episode offers a unique portrait of a destination through the eyes of Belgians who have built new lives far from Belgium, while highlighting the diversity of cultures and experiences found around the world.

programme.title: LES BELGES DU BOUT DU MONDE
programme.desc: Les Belges du Bout du Monde merupakan program majalah perjalanan dan budaya Belgia yang dipandu oleh Adrien Joveneau. Acara ini mengajak penonton menjelajahi berbagai negara melalui kisah warga Belgia yang memilih membangun kehidupan jauh dari tanah kelahiran mereka. Setiap episode menghadirkan wawancara dengan para ekspatriat, eksplorasi budaya lokal, serta cerita tentang perjalanan, adaptasi, dan hubungan antarmanusia. Dengan pendekatan yang hangat dan penuh rasa ingin tahu, program ini memperlihatkan keberagaman dunia sekaligus pengalaman unik orang Belgia yang hidup di berbagai penjuru bumi.

programme.title: UN SI GRAND SOLEIL
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: BÊTES DE FILM
programme.desc: BÊTES DE FILM goes behind the scenes to reveal how talented animal performers are trained and cared for while highlighting their memorable contributions to cinema and television.

programme.title: BÊTES DE FILM
programme.desc: BÊTES DE FILM mengajak penonton melihat proses pelatihan dan perawatan hewan-hewan yang tampil di dunia perfilman, sekaligus menampilkan kontribusi mereka dalam berbagai karya terkenal.

programme.title: LES SAISONS DE PIQUE-ASSIETTE
programme.desc: Les Saisons de Pique-Assiette follows host Annick Jeanmairet as she explores Switzerland’s culinary heritage through the changing seasons. Each episode focuses on fresh local ingredients, traditional recipes, and the people behind them—from farmers and fishermen to cheesemakers and artisans. Combining cooking demonstrations with visits to producers and picturesque regions, the series promotes seasonal eating, sustainable food practices, and a deeper appreciation of Swiss culture and gastronomy.

programme.title: LES SAISONS DE PIQUE-ASSIETTE
programme.desc: Les Saisons de Pique-Assiette mengajak penonton menjelajahi kekayaan kuliner Swiss bersama pembawa acara Annick Jeanmairet. Setiap episode menampilkan bahan-bahan segar yang sedang musim, resep khas daerah, serta kisah para petani, nelayan, pembuat keju, dan produsen lokal yang menjaga tradisi pangan Swiss. Selain menyuguhkan demonstrasi memasak yang inspiratif, program ini juga memperlihatkan keindahan alam dan budaya setempat, sekaligus mengedukasi penonton tentang pentingnya memasak dengan bahan lokal, menghargai siklus musim, dan menerapkan pola konsumsi yang lebih berkelanjutan.

programme.title: RASSEMBLANCE
programme.desc: Rassemblance tells intimate human stories focused on family connections, shared histories, and the emotional bonds that shape individual identity.

programme.title: RASSEMBLANCE

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: IDÉFIX ET LES IRRÉDUCTIBLES
programme.desc: Idéfix et les Irréductibles centers on Idéfix and his animal friends as they protect nature and resist Roman occupation, blending humor, adventure, and friendship.

programme.title: IDÉFIX ET LES IRRÉDUCTIBLES
programme.desc: Idéfix et les Irréductibles menampilkan Idéfix dan para sahabatnya yang berjuang melindungi alam dengan kisah penuh humor dan persahabatan.

programme.title: LES QUIQUOI
programme.desc: Olive, Pétole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: ROCKY & LILY : C'EST DANS LA BOÎTE !
programme.desc: Rocky & Lily : C’est dans la Boîte ! follows two playful characters as they imagine worlds and adventures using everyday objects, encouraging creativity and imagination for young viewers.

programme.title: ROCKY & LILY : C'EST DANS LA BOÎTE !
programme.desc: Rocky & Lily : C’est dans la Boîte ! mengajak anak-anak berimajinasi melalui petualangan kreatif yang lahir dari benda sehari-hari.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Set in the fantastical world of Virmark, Drazilion follows Oli, Emma, Fabio, and Rachel as they journey across mysterious lands filled with extraordinary creatures. Driven by their desire to find Drazilion, the mythical mother of all creatures, the friends encounter unexpected adventures, solve problems, and overcome obstacles together. Through their travels, they learn important lessons about courage, cooperation, respect for nature, and the bonds of friendship. Combining fantasy, humor, and adventure, the series offers an imaginative experience for young audiences.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. Dengan perpaduan fantasi, humor, dan aksi yang ringan, serial animasi ini menghadirkan pengalaman yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif bagi anak-anak.

programme.title: TOUT LE MONDE VEUT PRENDRE SA PLACE
programme.desc: Tout le Monde Veut Prendre sa Place is a popular quiz show where challengers test their knowledge to dethrone the reigning champion and claim the winner’s seat.

programme.title: TOUT LE MONDE VEUT PRENDRE SA PLACE
programme.desc: Tout le Monde Veut Prendre sa Place adalah kuis populer di mana peserta menantang juara bertahan untuk merebut posisi teratas.

programme.title: UN SI GRAND SOLEIL
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: TEMPS PRÉSENT
programme.desc: 'Temps Présent'' tackles current events broadly speaking. With its in-depth investigations and critical vision, the programme sheds light on the crises and the conflicts of our time, while denouncing the malfunctions of our society.

programme.title: LE JOURNAL DE FRANCE 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (8 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: SIX MOIS POUR APPRENDRE LE FRANÇAIS
programme.desc: This documentary follows people from different backgrounds as they spend six months learning French. Beyond vocabulary and grammar, their journey reveals the role of language in building relationships, adapting to a new environment, accessing opportunities, and discovering French culture through everyday experiences.

programme.title: SIX MOIS POUR APPRENDRE LE FRANÇAIS
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini mengikuti orang-orang dari berbagai latar belakang yang menjalani proses belajar bahasa Prancis selama enam bulan. Lebih dari sekadar tata bahasa dan kosakata, perjalanan mereka menunjukkan peran bahasa dalam membangun hubungan, beradaptasi dengan lingkungan baru, membuka peluang, dan mengenal budaya Prancis.

programme.title: IA, L'ANGLE MORT
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence reshapes everyday life, this documentary investigates the hidden risks of automated systems. Through victims, experts, and decision-makers, it explores algorithmic bias, opaque decisions, and the impact of AI on equality, democracy, and individual rights, asking who benefits from this powerful technology.

programme.title: IA, L'ANGLE MORT
programme.desc: Seiring kecerdasan buatan semakin memengaruhi kehidupan sehari-hari, dokumenter ini menyelidiki risiko tersembunyi dari sistem otomatis. Melalui kisah korban dan pandangan ahli, program ini membahas bias algoritma, keputusan yang tidak transparan, serta dampaknya terhadap kesetaraan, demokrasi, dan hak individu.

programme.title: ÉCHAPPÉES BELLES
programme.desc: In 2010, the Midi-Pyrénées represented the French region with the highest number of individual farms. Ismaël Khelifa takes us to meet those for whom farming has always been a passion, often a vocation, striving ever-harder to showcase their work and their produce.

programme.title: SECRETS DES PROFONDEURS
programme.desc: With Alex-William Miousse, Mario and Samuel are hoping to identify a wreck discovered in 2018. Their investigation has led them to a plausible theory: it could well be the ''Wearmouth'', a British iron-built steamship, first launched in 1880.

programme.title: L'ABÎME
programme.desc: L'Abîme follows Laurent Lacaze, whose life is shattered when his wife Elsa vanishes without a trace. While the police search for answers, they uncover evidence that Elsa is not the woman everyone believed her to be. Forced to confront the possibility that his wife has lived under a false identity, Laurent embarks on a desperate quest to uncover her past. As buried secrets emerge and new threats arise, the investigation reveals a complex conspiracy that puts both Laurent and their daughter in grave danger. Combining psychological suspense with family drama, the series keeps viewers guessing until the very end.

programme.title: L'ABÎME

programme.title: 3 Meals A Day: Light, Ep 3
programme.desc: In a rural South Korean village, a cast of chefs forage for local ingredients to craft meals over three days, joined by celebrity guests from Seoul for dinner each evening.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 6
programme.desc: Fresh off the Sea returns for its 3rd season. A real 'Fishing to Dining' life with harder work and a more colorful seasonal table. Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, and Roh Yoon Seo travel to seas, fields, and rivers to harvest fresh seasonal ingredients. They turn their hard work into hearty meals.

programme.title: Fresh Off The Sea S3, Ep 6
programme.desc: Fresh off the Sea kembali dengan musim ketiganya, menghadirkan kehidupan nyata bertema "dari laut ke meja makan" dengan tantangan yang lebih berat dan sajian musiman yang semakin beragam. Yum Jung Ah, Kim Sun Young, Kang You Seok, dan Roh Yoon Seo menjelajahi laut, ladang, serta sungai untuk memanen bahan-bahan segar sesuai musim, lalu mengolah hasil kerja keras mereka menjadi hidangan lezat.

programme.desc: Setelah dibebaskan dari penjara, seorang pria mengetahui bahwa ia memiliki seorang putri, sehingga ia ingin meninggalkan geng dan menjalani kehidupan biasa. Namun, pemimpin baru geng tersebut merasa dikhianati.

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Love Barista follows Kang Jun-woo, a Korean celebrity whose career is beginning to decline. While traveling to Vietnam for a commercial shoot, a series of mishaps leaves him stranded without money, a passport, or his manager. As he struggles to adapt to his unfamiliar surroundings, he meets Thao, a cheerful young woman pursuing her dream of becoming a barista. Despite their cultural and language differences, the two gradually develop a meaningful connection. Through humor, friendship, and romance, the film explores second chances, personal growth, and the unexpected relationships that can change a person's life.

programme.title: Love Barista
programme.desc: Love Barista mengisahkan Kang Jun-woo, seorang aktor ternama Korea Selatan yang kariernya mulai meredup. Saat melakukan perjalanan ke Vietnam untuk syuting iklan, sebuah kesalahan membuatnya tertinggal tanpa paspor, uang, maupun manajernya. Dalam kondisi yang serba sulit, ia bertemu Thao, seorang perempuan lokal yang sedang berjuang mewujudkan impiannya menjadi barista profesional. Seiring waktu, keduanya saling membantu dan mulai memahami perbedaan budaya serta latar belakang masing-masing. Hubungan yang awalnya tidak disengaja berkembang menjadi kisah cinta yang manis, sembari mengajarkan arti keberanian, harapan, dan kesempatan kedua dalam hidup.

programme.desc: Manda and Indy are sisters who love each other dearly. Their mother, Rianty, died while giving birth to Indy. Since then, Manda and Indy have lived as a family of three with their father, Indra. Manda has taken on the role of a mother to Indy. One day, their father began to fall ill and was admitted to the hospital. It turned out that Indra had leukemia.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.
